The '''Argofay Traffickers''' are a group of {{Green|4}} [[NPCs]] located in the {{zone|Wyld Woods}}. Each of them sells a piece of [[Wyld Armor]].

{{/UI}}

{{Ahn|exclusive=yes}} {{Infobox/Character |dont_submit_to_bucket = Yes |location=Village |x=2 |y=77 |z=-5 }} '''Centauri''' is an [[NPC]] exclusive to the [[Alpha Hypixel Network|Alpha Network]]. They are located in front of the {{zone|Community Center}}, and grant {{c}}, {{Item|Booster Cookie}}s, item upgrades and update-featured items. == Interface == {{/UI}} == Usage == '''Centauri''' can be accessed by talking to them in the Hub, or via the {{code|/centauri}} command anywhere. The interface has three parts. === Featured Update Items === {{Quote|Claim featured items related to this update.}} This menu is a shop that sells items featured in an update for {{Coins|1}} each. === Coin Generator === This menu gives player any amount of money. Available options are: {{Coins|1k}}, {{Coins|10k}}, {{Coins|100k}}, {{Coins|1m}}, {{Coins|10m}}, {{Coins|100m}}, {{Coins|1b}}, and "Custom Amount". === Toy Box === {{Quote|A variety of useful and cheaty utilities to make your life easier!}} This menu contains other features available to the player. These features applies an effect to a player, and are claimable for any amount of times and without cool down. {| class="wikitable" ! Feature !! Description |- | Cookie Jar | When clicked, it gives the player the effect of a {{Item|Booster Cookie}}, as if the player has consumed one.
Duration granted: {{Green|292,471,155 years, 208 days, 9 hours and 15 minutes}} in real-life time |- | Potion Seller | When clicked, it gives the player all potion effects of a {{Item|God Potion}}, as if the player has consumed one.
Duration granted: {{Green|292,471,155 years, 208 days, 9 hours and 15 minutes}} in real-life time |- | Max Items | When clicked, it makes the following changes to all armor pieces and items in the player's inventory (not including items in [[Storage]] and [[Wardrobe]]) if applicable: * Maximum [[Enchantments]] * [[Recombobulator 3000#Usage|Recombobulate]] * A fixed [[Reforge]] depending on the item's type, overriding any existing reforge on the item. If there is no set reforge for that category, the previous reforge, if any, stays on the item. Currently, this feature does not change any [[Gemstone]] slot on items. |- | Duplicate Items | When clicked when holding an item, it duplicates the item in the player's inventory. |- | Max Collections | When clicked, for all [[Collection]] items that has not reached its maximum tier, the collection amount is set to the requirement for the highest tier, meaning all tiers are unlocked. |- | Max Skills | When clicked, for all [[Skills]] that has not reached its maximum level except {{Skill|Dungeoneering}}, its skill XP is set to an arbitrarily high number, meaning all levels are unlocked. |- | Max Slayers | When clicked, all [[Slayer|Slayers]] are increased to their maximum level. |- | 50k HOTM EXP | When clicked, the player instantly gains 50,000 [[HotM Experience|HotM EXP]]. |- | Big 'ol chunk o' Powder! | When clicked, the player instantly gains 2,000,000 [[Mithril Powder|Mithril]] and [[Gemstone Powder|Gemstone]] powder. |- | 5k Gems | When clicked, the player's [[Gems]] purse is set to {{Green|5,000}}. |- | Set RNG Meter Progress | When clicked, the player is prompted to enter an amount of XP for all the player's [[RNG Meter]]s progress to be set to. |- | Clear RNG Meter Progress | When clicked, the player's RNG Meters' progress is set to 0. |- | Fill Agatha's Rewards | Gives you rewards for [[Agatha]]'s contests as if you had participated in 25 of them. |- | Big 'ol chunk o' Whispers! | When clicked, the player instantly gains 1,000,000 {{Turquoise|Forest Whispers}}. |- | Shards! | When clicked, the player instantly gains 10 of every available {{Item|Attribute Shard}}. |- |} ==== Reforges ==== '''Centauri''' applies the following reforges when using Max Items: {| class="wikitable centertext" |- ! Type ! Have you met Sam on your private island? I hear she needs help with a farm or something...}} |- | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &8&lCentauri&r: Hi there! Make sure to talk to Sam on your private island to go to the Garden if you are at least SkyBlock level 5!}} |- | class="ct" rowspan="2" | After finishing [[Sam]]'s introduction | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &8&lCentauri&r: Welcome.}} |- | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &8&lCentauri&r: Hello There.}} |} == Trivia == *'''Centauri''''s comments when the player claims potion effects is a reference to the infamous [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R_FQU4KzN7A potion seller meme]. *'''Centauri''''s skin is based off [https://www.destinypedia.com/Xûr Xûr] from the Destiny franchise. *'''Centauri''' and the fact that they are exclusive to the [[Alpha Hypixel Network|Alpha Network]] is a reference to the triple star system [[w:Alpha Centauri|Alpha Centauri]]. *The line "I solemnly swear I am up to no good.", despite not being verbatim, comes from Harry Potter, where it was used to access the [[fandom:harrypotter:Marauder's_Map#Usage|Marauder's Map]]. *The max collection feature works for [[Jacob's Farming Contest]]s and can be clicked multiple times to max the collections over and over. *The maximum number of coins that can be generated at once is 2^{63}-1 = 9,223,372,036,854,775,807 (9.223 quintillion or 9.223372e+18), which is the 64-bit signed integer limit. Attempting to generate more coins than this will cap it to this value. However, this can be repeated multiple times, and the player's purse can hold more than that. *It is possible to generate a negative amount of coins, which will take coins from your purse instead of adding to it. **It used to be possible to make your purse go negative with this, but that appears to have been patched. *You can duplicate an item even if your inventory is full. It will appear to succeed, but it will actually silently fail rather than being added to your [[Item Stash]] or [[Material Stash]]. == Gallery == Centauri (Pickaxe).png|'''Centuari''' during the Modernized Mining [[Alpha Hypixel Network|Alpha]] == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2023/Jan 26|[[File:Centauri.png|26px]] Added '''Centauri'''.|Featured Items has [[Garden]]-related items for this update.}} {{History|2023/May 4|Added {{Abbr|'''3'''|These are Duplicate Item, Max Collections, and Max Skills.}} more utilities in the Toy Box.}} {{History|0.19.8|Max Skills now also maxes {{skill|Catacombs}} skill.}} {{History|2024/Jan 29|Alpha Hypixel Network opens without '''Centauri''' appearing.}} {{History|2024/Jan 31|Alpha Hypixel Network opens with '''Centauri''' appearing again.|Added Max Slayers option in Toy Box.|Featured Items has {{Item|God Potion}}s and [[Mixins]] for this update.}} {{History|2024/March 21|Alpha Hypixel Network opens with '''Centauri''' once again returning|Added 50k HOTM EXP and Big Ol' chunk o' Powder! options in Toy Box|Featured Items has Mining items for the [[Glacite Tunnels]]}} {{History|2024/April 9|Alpha Hypixel Network reopens with '''Centauri''' again featuring|No items are featured in this Alpha session and Centauri's UI and dialogue are still left over from the previous session}} {{History|2024/April 9|'''Centauri''' is updated to change the name of his GUI for the featured update and to replace his dialogue}} {{History|2024/May 3|Alpha Hypixel Network reopens with '''Centauri''' having new dialogue and featured items for Dragons}} {{History|2024/June 3|Alpha Hypixel Network reopens with '''Centauri''' returning.|Added 5k Gems option in Toy Box.|Featured Items has items for Better Mayors.}} {{History|unknown|'''Centauri''' can now be accessed anywhere via the {{code|/centauri}} command.}} {{History|2024/June 10|link=none|Updated Featured Items for the Better Mayors update.}} {{History|2024/July 31|Alpha Hypixel Network reopens with '''Centauri''' returning.|Featured Items has items for Artist's Abode.}} {{History|2024/August 20|Alpha Hypixel Network reopens with '''Centauri''' returning.|Featured Items has items for Modernized Mining.}} {{History|2024/Sept 11|Alpha Hypixel Network reopens with '''Centauri''' returning.|Featured Items are the same as previous appearance.|Alpha Checklist is not available.}} {{History|2024/Oct 2|Alpha Hypixel Network reopens with '''Centauri''' returning.|Featured Items contains only {{Item|Dirt}}.|Alpha Checklist is not available.|Fixed Duplicate Item not working when not in the Hub.}} {{History|2024/Nov 13|Alpha Hypixel Network reopens with '''Centauri''' returning.|Featured Items contains items for the 0.20.8 update.|Alpha Checklist is not available.}} {{History|2025/Jan 15|Alpha Hypixel Network reopens with '''Centauri''' returning.|Featured Items contains items for the 0.21.1 update.|Alpha Checklist is not available.}} }}

The '''Shepherd''' is an [[NPC]] located in the house in the {{zone|Shepherd's Keep}} in the [[Mushroom Desert]]. He gives the player the task of shearing all his sheep at once. After having all the [[Sheep]] sheared at once, the '''Shepherd''' will reward the player with {{Pelts|+4}}.

__TOC__

== Dialogue ==
{{DialogueGrammar}}
{| class="wikitable"
!Condition
!Dialogue
|-
| class="ct" | First Interaction
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] Shepherd&f: Hello traveler!
&e[NPC] Shepherd&f: Welcome to my keep, my sheep are some of the best in the world.
&e[NPC] Shepherd&f: They have regenerative properties that allow for them to regenerate their wool faster than normal!
&e[NPC] Shepherd&f: I'm feeling tired today.
&e[NPC] Shepherd&f: Could you shear all my sheep at once?
&e[NPC] Shepherd&f: I will have a reward if you do so!
}}
|-
| class="ct" | Not all [[Sheep]] Sheared
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Shepherd&f: You didn't shear enough sheep!}}
|-
| class="ct" | All [[Sheep]] Sheared
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] Shepherd&f: Thanks for helping me out!
&e[NPC] Shepherd&f: Please accept this as a token of my gratitude!
&5+4 Pelts
}}
|-
!Condition
!Random Dialogue
|-
| class="ct" | After Shearing all [[Sheep]]
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Shepherd&f: My sheep are some of the best in the world!}}
|}

== Tips ==
*Shearing all the sheep at once is a difficult task, without a [[God Potion]] or other serious speed boosts.
*Players can gather all sheep using leads and bring them to just in front of the Shepherd's house to quickly shear all the sheep at the same time.
*Killing the sheep isn't helpful, as the player would have to wait for them to respawn.

The '''Three Bears''' are a group of [[NPC]]s found in the [[Crystal Hollows]]. They begin as '''Pete''', '''Keith''', and '''Ede''' and tell the player a story. At the end of the story, the player is given the blindness effect and the NPCs turn into bears and disappear.

Once they have been spoken to, Pete will have a chance to visit the player's [[The Garden|Garden]] in his bear form.

== Dialogue ==
{{DialogueGrammar}}
{| class="wikitable"
! colspan="2" | Condition
! Dialogue
|- class="article-row-main"
| colspan="2" class="ct" | First Interaction
| {{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] Pete&f: Pal, you seem a lil' lost over there,
&e[NPC] Keith&f: Why don'tcha come by the fire and sit down anywhere
&e[NPC] Ede&f: I gotcha ya a good story piling up, but beware!
&e[NPC] Pete&f: It's the scary story about the big bad bear
&e[NPC] Keith&f: There was once a baby bear, little and cute,
&e[NPC] Ede&f: but her parents, oh no!, they were quite the brute
&e[NPC] Pete&f: they'd always throw tantrums about what and who,
&e[NPC] Keith&f: but the lil' bear had enough and said "that's my cue!"
&e[NPC] Ede&f: so the lil' fellow went out and about into the wood,
&e[NPC] Pete&f: but what came of that, let me tell you, it didn't end very good
&e[NPC] Keith&f: she found an empty cabin, rusty and old,
&e[NPC] Ede&f: "a bit of rest wouldn't hurt" she said very bold
&e[NPC] Pete&f: "so he sat down by the chimney with paws freezing cold,
&e[NPC] Keith&f: and threw some wood and watched the fire unfold
&e[NPC] Ede&f: he tugged himself in and went right to sleep,
&e[NPC] Pete&f: but then something happened, the fire went out and he heard a loud creak
&e[NPC] Keith&f: he got up and looked deep down the darkness
&e[NPC] Ede&f: but what he then saw...
}}
|-
| rowspan="3" class="ct" | Pete in {{Zone|The Garden}}
| class="ct"| None
| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &9Pete&f: Horror stories are better when you have something to snack on y'know? If you help us gather some ingredients, we could roast some tasty marshmallows.}}
|-
| class="ct" | Completing
| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &9Pete&f: Thanks Pal! Why don't you sit around the campfire with us and enjoy these tasty treats?}}
|-
| class="ct" | Denying
| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &9Pete&f: No supplies? You wouldn't want to experience what the lil' bear did, would you?}}
|}

'''Udium''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{zone|Wizard Tower}}. They return items the player transferred to the [[Rift Dimension]] through bugs and exploits.

== Dialogue ==
{| class="wikitable"
! colspan="2" |Condition
!Dialogue
|-
| colspan="2" class="ct" |None
|{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &bUdium&f: &dMagic&f is very &cdangerous.
&e[NPC] &bUdium&f: One second everything is fine and the next, the world is ending.
&e[NPC] &bUdium&f: I was playing with a &5Sculk Catalyst&f in a different world from the future...
&e[NPC] &bUdium&f: And the &5sculk&f spread all over my body!
&e[NPC] &bUdium&f: Even &eAlatar&f, a powerful wizard...
&e[NPC] &bUdium&f: He just disappeared one day!
&e[NPC] &bUdium&f: Poof!
&e[NPC] &bUdium&f: No more &eAlatar&f!
}}
|-

|{{Dialogue|
&c-----------------------------------------------------
&r&f&r&5⚠ &r&4&lUH OH! &r&5&kXX&r&c Some of your items did not belong here!
&r&f&r&eVisit &r&bUdium &r&ein the Hub's Wizard Tower to get them &r&7(#) &r&eback!

}}

}}

== Trivia ==
* Udium references the [[mcw:Sculk Catalyst|Sculk Catalyst]] in their dialogue, stating that "[they were] playing with [it] in a different world from the future...", probably referencing ''Minecraft'' version 1.19, and how SkyBlock was still centered on version 1.8.9 when the NPC was released.
* Udium also mentions {{NPCSprite|Alatar}}, an NPC found in the Rift, who "disappeared."

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Avorius: I am quite thirsty all the time, it's a rare condition.

original_resources.source: [NPC] Avorius: I am quite thirsty all the time, it's a rare condition.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Avorius: Why are you looking at me that way? I am not a Vampire, you are!

original_resources.speaker: Avorius
original_resources.source: [NPC] Avorius: Why are you looking at me that way? I am not a Vampire, you are!

original_resources.translation: [NPC] Avorius: Здесь ещё и нет солнечного света. Вампиру было бы весьма уютно.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Friendly Hiker: Thanks! I'll be heading to look for him as soon as possible.

original_resources.speaker: Researcher Gilbert
original_resources.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Reach Fishing Level X and talk to Captain Baha on your Ship!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Hello!

original_resources.speaker: Researcher Gilbert
original_resources.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Hello!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Здравствуйте!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: I'm a researcher who focuses upon the study of Frogs!

original_resources.speaker: Researcher Gilbert
original_resources.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: I'm a researcher who focuses upon the study of Frogs!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Я исследователь, изучаю лягушек!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Well, I was a researcher, I suppose.

original_resources.speaker: Researcher Gilbert
original_resources.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Well, I was a researcher, I suppose.

original_resources.speaker: Researcher Gilbert
original_resources.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Today marks the first day of my retirement!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Сегодня мой первый день на пенсии!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Thank you!

original_resources.speaker: Researcher Gilbert
original_resources.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Thank you!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Спасибо!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Say, is that your Ship parked by the side of the island?

original_resources.speaker: Researcher Gilbert
original_resources.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Say, is that your Ship parked by the side of the island?
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Скажите, это ваш корабль стоит у берега острова?

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Hmm, might I be so bold as to ask if I could join you on your adventures?

original_resources.speaker: Researcher Gilbert
original_resources.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Hmm, might I be so bold as to ask if I could join you on your adventures?

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: I don't have a lot going on now, with retirement and all.

original_resources.speaker: Researcher Gilbert
original_resources.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: I don't have a lot going on now, with retirement and all.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Теперь, на пенсии, у меня не так много дел.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Amazing.

original_resources.speaker: Researcher Gilbert
original_resources.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Amazing.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Прекрасно.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Say, I would like a souvenir to take on my travels, though, to remember this place by.

original_resources.speaker: Researcher Gilbert
original_resources.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Say, I would like a souvenir to take on my travels, though, to remember this place by.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: If it's not too much trouble, might you be able to fish me up a Busted Belt Buckle?

original_resources.speaker: Researcher Gilbert
original_resources.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: If it's not too much trouble, might you be able to fish me up a Busted Belt Buckle?
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Если вам не трудно, выловите для меня сломанную пряжку пояса.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: As much of a dumping ground as this place is, it really feels like MY dumping ground, you know..?

original_resources.speaker: Researcher Gilbert
original_resources.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: As much of a dumping ground as this place is, it really feels like MY dumping ground, you know..?

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Do you have that souvenir for me?

original_resources.speaker: Researcher Gilbert
original_resources.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Do you have that souvenir for me?
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Вы принесли мой сувенир?

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Amazing, thank you so much!

original_resources.speaker: Researcher Gilbert
original_resources.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Amazing, thank you so much!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Прекрасно, огромное спасибо!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: I'll go introduce myself to the rest of the crew!

original_resources.speaker: Researcher Gilbert
original_resources.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: I'll go introduce myself to the rest of the crew!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Пойду познакомлюсь с остальными членами экипажа!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Anchors away!

original_resources.speaker: Researcher Gilbert
original_resources.source: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Anchors away!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Researcher Gilbert: Поднять якоря!
